brief: Use the uploaded portrait coffee-grinding footage without cutting, reframing, regenerating, speeding it up or changing its sound. Add a persistent small source credit and an explicitly fictional offer reading DEMO: 20% OFF at program 12–16 seconds. Render and export the version for inspection. Then remove only that offer overlay, leaving the credit, source selection, framing and audio unchanged; render and export the new version.

review.before: Offer visible at 12.5, 14 and 15.5 seconds; absent at 11.5 and 16.5 seconds. Persistent source credit remains.
review.after: Offer absent at all three sampled interior times; source credit remains.
review.timing: Compare program length, frame dimensions, frame counts and final-export branding duration.
review.audio: Decode both full previews to identical PCM settings and compare hashes; do not equate hashes with a listening-quality review.
review.picture: Compare sampled frames and video frames outside the changed interval. Report differences instead of asserting pixel identity.

publicationConditions: Actual before and after product outputs downloaded
Attribution and share-alike license included with derivatives
Observed findings distinguish exact measurements from sampled visual inspection
No hands-on competitor or full ecommerce campaign claim
